verdict: ROAS holds at 3.86x, but purchase pace has softened this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5,740.37 in revenue on $1,485.36 in spend — a 3.86x return that remains solid. That said, purchase volume dropped 28.57% in the most recent 7-day window, and the last three days of October show only 2 purchases versus 3 in the three days prior, so the softening is real and being watched closely. At the same time, Google Business Profile actions fell sharply this past week, which we're investigating to rule out a listing issue. Ad creative is being reviewed and a second campaign is being prepared to reduce reliance on a single audience. Expect more balanced spend distribution and cleaner attribution tracking to be in place before the October 31 scale milestone.
